overall_topic.topic: Debate on Sonia Gandhi's Memoir and Historical Controversies
overall_topic.description: A televised debate analyzing Sonia Gandhi's newly released memoir, focusing on whether it is a genuine personal account or a politically curated attempt to whitewash major historical events such as the Emergency, Operation Blue Star, the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, and the Babri Masjid demolition.
